nettle/fuzz_rsa_public_key_from_der.c.why: data IS consumed, by asn1_der_iterator_first(&iter, size, data) -- the call sits inside an if() condition and the lifter does not read calls in conditional expressions

haproxy/fuzz_cfg_parser.c.why: data reaches the parser through a designated struct initialiser (.content = (const char *)data); the lifter does not follow input into an aggregate initialiser

lcms/cms_cie_cam02_fuzzer.c.why: input is consumed byte-wise as data[0], data[1]...; and the stack struct is a plain local declaration the lifter does not count as a create

tdengine/sql-fuzzer.c.why: locals passed by address are read as resources that were never created

result: 0 upstream-reportable findings; 4 flags, all four false
the_actual_finding: the HIGH-FIDELITY classifier admitted all four. The gates are correct about the IR they were handed; the LIFTER produced IR that does not match the harness, and the fidelity signal -- 'the lifter could not attribute some values' -- did not fire on any of them. A fidelity signal that misses four out of four is the defect, not the gates.
CORRECTION: The population figures first recorded here (214 high-fidelity, 4 flagged, 1.9%) were produced by a script that detected fidelity by GREPPING THE CLI OUTPUT for 'could not attribute'. Changing that message then made 130 harnesses appear to become high-fidelity and the flags appear to vanish -- a result manufactured entirely by the measuring script. The audit is re-run through the lifter's API below. The four triage verdicts stand; they came from reading the harnesses, not from the script.

triage.yajl-ruby/json_fuzzer.c: FALSE POSITIVE - `yajl_parser_config cfg = {...}` is a declared local passed as &cfg; the lifter does not count a designated-initialiser declaration as a create
triage.bluez/fuzz_gobex.c: FALSE POSITIVE - same shape: a local passed by address, which for an out-parameter is uninitialised BY DESIGN
triage.sentencepiece/trainer_fuzzer.cc: S2.UNKNOWN_PARAM, not triaged in this round

after_fidelity_fix.remaining_lifter_gap: A CALLER-DECLARED LOCAL PASSED BY ADDRESS IS NOT AN UNCREATED RESOURCE. This one shape produced the tdengine, lcms, yajl-ruby and bluez flags -- it is the single largest false-positive source left, and fixing it is the prerequisite for running this audit for findings rather than for calibration.

fidelity_fixes_made: a call in the body that never became an op now makes the lift untrusted
a use of the data or size parameter that was never bound now makes it untrusted
comparison guards (`if (size < 4)`) are excluded, because counting them rejected a correctly lifted branching harness -- fail closed, but not shut
